style: specific, evidence-aware research-proposal agenda (revised from general proposal agenda)
nature: Proposed studies from a local research-status synthesis; NOT accepted results, NOT citation-bound evidence, NOT product binding. 'What studies already show' = the synthesis in plain words (model-only/single-sample flagged). Survey names = proposed data to use.

proposals.title: When does AGN feedback dominate galaxy quenching?
proposals.research_question: In which regime of halo mass/environment/redshift is AGN feedback the leading quenching channel?
proposals.known: central BH/bulge/sigma correlate with quenching; AGN is one channel among several; countercases active
proposals.unknown: causal channel at fixed halo mass/environment/stellar mass (AGN-power vs host-structure degeneracy)
proposals.test: regress quenched fraction on AGN power at fixed host props; compare to counterfactuals

proposals.title: Comparable-denominator census of AGN outflows
proposals.research_question: Outflow incidence by tracer/selection under one denominator?
proposals.known: ~17% ionized (one sample) vs ~46% neutral (another) are tracer/selection-specific and must not be merged
proposals.unknown: population-wide frequency under common selection/denominator, by phase and redshift
proposals.test: one selection+grid; per-tracer fractions at identical thresholds; explicit denominators

proposals.title: Gas reservoirs and star-formation efficiency
proposals.research_question: Gas-poor (removed) vs gas-retaining-inefficient quenching; where do AGN hosts fall?
proposals.known: central-kpc depletion in some; retained gas + low SFE in others; expulsion != galaxy-wide loss
proposals.unknown: frequency of removed vs retained-inefficient; whether AGN tracks central depletion specifically
proposals.test: depletion time vs AGN stage & radius; classify; test central-depletion association

proposals.title: Observational program for maintenance heating
proposals.research_question: Does radio-mode heating balance cooling as an observed duty cycle?
proposals.known: maintenance heating rendered model-dependent (simulation-supported, not observed here); distinct from ejective
proposals.unknown: whether observed heating power balances cooling luminosity across controlled halo mass
proposals.test: heating power vs X-ray cooling luminosity, halo-mass-controlled, duty-cycle-averaged

proposals.title: Validating simulation predictions vs unbiased observations
proposals.research_question: Which simulation predictions survive forward-modeled comparison to unbiased samples?
proposals.known: simulation-only statements labeled model-dependent; simulations show what mechanisms can produce, not prevalence
proposals.unknown: which predictions match observations once selection is applied
proposals.test: forward-model into survey selection; compare predicted vs observed; flag selection-only predictions

proposals.title: Filling lightly-covered channels: chemical/structural/high-z
proposals.research_question: Which under-mapped channels can rank against AGN feedback, and which need new data?
proposals.known: MZR modest scatter at cosmic noon; FMR ~stable to ~0.1 dex to z~2.3; reionization frontier open debates; halo/morphology scoped on unverified rows
proposals.unknown: whether these channels can rank against AGN feedback; redshift-resolved behavior beyond scoped ranges
proposals.test: redshift-resolved scaling relations + halo-regulation vs AGN channel weight

no_invention: No invented paper titles, DOI/ADS records, numeric findings, or source IDs. Concrete anchors (17%/46% fractions, ~0.1 dex FMR, z>10 tension) are quoted from the local M3 synthesis. Survey families = proposed data to use.
